facts.fact: The Togo government ICT specifications guide states Togocom has deployed a backbone of about 1,500 km north to south on the axes Lome-Atakpame-Cinkasse, Lome-Kpalime-Atakpame and Lome-Aneho, 24 fibres per link, doubled around Lome and on Atakpame-Kara and Kara-Cinkasse; no date given for deployment, so the document's published date 2023-02-20 is used.

note: Reports a Dec 2020 decree requiring fibre on new civil works; a regulatory measure with no contract or works on a national backbone and no stated in-service route.

systems.country_label: reseaux de fibre optique deployes pour la SIN

note: Decree of 2020-12-23 is a dig-once rule (contractors lay fibre owned by SIN), a transfer of unlicensed networks to SIN and a duty on SIN to give licensed operators access to what it operates; it states no backbone built, in service or reaching regions, and names no inter-regional backbone, so no reach or access fact is recorded.

facts.fact: ARCEP Togo's decision 003/ARCEP/DG/25 caps wholesale prices for access to national transmission infrastructure, cutting monthly dark fibre rental from 75 to 30 FCFA per metre.

note: Fibre to 2,700 schools and 250 hospitals is planned and is not a backbone.
